Because they truly abide, this sutra will endure and be upheld;
with great compassion as their armor and great loving-kindness as their secure dwelling,
through the power of their loving-kindness, this sutra will endure and be upheld.

through the convergence of all these accumulations, this sutra increases its abiding power.

asuras, devas, nāgas, and gandharvas, having established it, have performed [this work].

Because it accords with the holy life (*brahmacarya*), it is adorned by the four truths.

we have aroused the desire for diligence and now manifest it extensively.

I shall uphold this sūtra and preach it for ten million devas;

At that time, the Bodhisattva Maitreya addressed the Buddha with these verses:

For the sake of guarding all dharmas, One is able to relinquish one's own body."

When the Buddha spoke these words, the goddesses such as Bodhivṛkṣaśāntā, Mahāprajñā, and Śrīdevī, along with the hosts of devas—headed by Śakra, Brahmā, and Viśvāmitra—the various celestial kings, the great assemblies of devas, gandharvas, asuras, and all other beings in the world, were all filled with great joy at what the Buddha had said.

At that time, Śākyamuni Buddha arose from samādhi and manifested great supernormal powers. With his right hand, he stroked the crowns of the heads of the great bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, as well as the various heavenly kings, dragon kings, and the twenty-eight divisions of the general Vaiśravaṇa spirits, and spoke these words:

"For immeasurable hundreds of thousands of myriads of koṭis of Ganges-sands of kalpas, I have cultivated this subtle and wondrous *Suvarṇaprabhāsottama* Sūtra. You all should receive, uphold, read, recite, and widely proclaim this Dharma, ensuring that it shall not be severed within Jambudvīpa."

If there are good men or good women who, in future ages, receive, uphold, read, and recite this sutra, you gods should always protect them. You should know that such persons will constantly experience happiness among immeasurable hundreds of thousands of humans and devas in future ages, will encounter various Buddhas in future ages, and will swiftly realize and attain *anuttara-samyak-saṃbodhi*.

At that time, the great bodhisattvas, as well as the devas, nāga kings, and the twenty-eight divisions of the Great General Saṃjñeya, rose from their seats, went before the Buddha, prostrated themselves with their five limbs touching the ground, and together raised their voices, saying:
"As the World-Honored One has commanded, we shall carry it out in full."
Thus he spoke three times:
"As the World-Honored One has commanded, we shall carry it out in full.
Thereupon, the Great General Vajrapāṇi addressed the Buddha, saying:
“World-Honored One!

If in a future age there are those who receive and uphold this sutra—whether copying it themselves or having others copy it—I shall always attend and protect these twenty-eight classes of spirits and deities, concealing our forms, so that all evils of these Dharma-preachers may be extinguished and they may attain peace and security; may you have no cause for concern.”
At that time, Śākyamuni Buddha manifested great supernatural power, causing immeasurable worlds in the ten directions to tremble in six ways.
At that moment, all the Buddhas were filled with great joy; because they were entrusting this sutra to them, they praised those who uphold the Dharma and manifested immeasurable supernatural powers.

Thereupon, the great assembly of immeasurable, boundless, and incalculable bodhisattva-mahāsattvas—including the Bodhisattva Śraddhālakṣaṇa, Suvarṇaprabha, Suvarṇagarbha, Sadāśoka, Dharmodgata, and others—as well as the four heavenly kings, ten thousand devaputras, the tree deity of the bodhimaṇḍa, the earth deity Dṛḍhā, and all the world’s devas, humans, asuras, and so forth, having heard what the Buddha taught, all resolved upon unexcelled bodhicitta. Elated and filled with joy, they paid homage and departed.
The Combined Edition of the Suvarṇaprabhāsottama-sūtra, Volume Eight.
